get_data: parse a JSON file of DFT and force field data points into CO2 and H2O categories
binned_average: compute the average prediction error within specified energy bins for DFT adsorption data
bin_plot: plot a manual histogram bar chart on a matplotlib axis with custom bin widths
get_Fig4a: generate a histogram of raw force field versus DFT errors for CO2 and H2O
phys_err: calculate the mean absolute error for physisorption data points between 0 and negative 0.5 eV
